text:
Once upon a time, in a vast ocean, lived a whale named Whaley. Whaley was a happy whale, but he had one dream - to see the world beyond the sea.

One day, while swimming, Whaley saw a beautiful walnut tree on an island. The tree sparkled in the sunlight, and its leaves danced with the wind. Whaley was mesmerized by the tree's beauty and decided to visit the island.

As he approached the island, he saw that the walnut tree had the most delicious-looking nuts he had ever seen. Whaley was curious, so he asked the tree if he could have some nuts. The tree, being a kind and generous tree, agreed and offered Whaley some nuts.

Whaley was delighted and ate the nuts with great pleasure. He had never tasted anything like them before. The tree and Whaley became great friends, and Whaley visited the tree often.

One day, as Whaley was swimming near the island, he saw that the walnut tree was in danger. A group of beavers had come to the island and were cutting down trees to build their homes. Whaley knew he had to help his friend.

He swam to the island and asked the beavers to stop. The beavers didn't understand why they should stop, so Whaley used his powerful tail to create a big wave that knocked the beavers off the island.

The beavers were surprised and scared, but they quickly realized that Whaley had saved their homes from the tree that offered him nuts. They apologized to the walnut tree and promised never to harm it again.

Whaley and the walnut tree continued to be friends, and Whaley visited the island often. He would bring back gifts from the ocean, and the tree would offer him nuts and shelter. They were happy knowing that their friendship had saved the walnut tree and the beavers' homes.

And so, the haiku goes:

A whale's dream,
A tree's gift,
Friendship saves the day.
